fork_status_and_schedule.highlight: EF/ChainSecurity/DDOB contacted 50+ affected companies; all highs fix by mid-Dec, mediums by Jan 10
Glamsterdam mainnet target: mid-Jan earliest (no spec changes); late-Jan/early-Feb more realistic
Hoodi fork week of Dec 14 (Dec 16–17) penciled in; go/no-go decision deferred to next ACDC

glamsterdam_spec_change_debate.highlight: No spec change has majority support; any change restarts full audit/devnet/testnet cycle (~months delay)
Marius: removing mid-tx refunds (most-cited candidate change) breaks contracts relying on intra-tx gas return; significant unknown blast radius
Client poll: Geth, Nethermind, Reth, ethrex favor current spec + schedule; Erigon prefers spec change; Besu reluctantly accepts current spec

hegota_scope.highlight: Scope options debated (1–5); rough landing zone between option 3 (core frames bundle only) and 4 (frames + select EIPs); option 1 (enshrine PQ, drop frames) has zero support
Besu/ethrex lean toward freezing at Hegota devnet 2 scope + adding leanSPHINCS/signature aggregation; Nethermind prefers not reducing unless it accelerates shipping
EIP-8151 (EC Recover deprecation) flagged as high-risk: preliminary scan shows many contracts depend on it; may not make Hegota
Greg Colvin: repeated EIP removals/delays cause planning hardship for champions; argues for sliding fork dates rather than dropping EIPs

frames_transaction_updates.highlight: Frames breakout: two open spec changes — (1) forward-compat with EIP-8288 signature list, (2) tree-root hashing scheme; target spec-complete before holiday break
ethrex (Iván) proposing minimal leanSPHINCS-on-frames EIP (ethereum/EIPs#12672); 8288-compatible, no prover/aggregation yet; targeting PFI next ACDE

pq_cryptography_discussion.highlight: MLDSA/lattice vs. leanSPHINCS debate: EF crypto team holds hash-based is most conservative; MLDSA verifier costs ~800k–1.5M gas with current optimizations
Mislav (Ethlabs): wallet/UX concern — leanSPHINCS non-standard may repeat secp256k1 adoption problems; frames should remain scheme-agnostic

hegota_devnets.highlight: Decision: no cross-layer DevNet until ACDC decides on FOCIL; EL-only DevNets remain separate
Default: pause at current EL DevNet scope; possible exception for cleanup EIPs if strong ACDT consensus Monday

action_items.action: EL devs favoring spec change: produce concrete candidate change with impact analysis before next ACDC
All client teams: submit one-paragraph Hegota scope position (option 2–5) by end of next week
Spencer: publish partial impact analysis doc for proposed Glamsterdam spec changes

decisions.decision: Glamsterdam will proceed with current spec (no changes); Hoodi fork targeting week of Dec 14 — formal go/no-go at next ACDC
Top Hegota scope option (drop frames, enshrine PQ directly) has zero support — effectively DFI'd; remaining options 2–4 open for two-week client team review
No cross-layer Hegota DevNet until FOCIL decision is made on ACDC; EL DevNets remain separate
EL DevNet scope paused at current level by default; ACDT Monday may greenlight cleanup EIPs only

targets.target: Hoodi fork — week of December 14, 2026 (Dec 16–17 likely); confirmed/cancelled at ACDC Nov 26
Frames spec-complete (all major changes merged) — before holiday break, mid-December 2026
